verification.uiLimitations: Actual Electron production assets, isolated synthetic project, deterministic injected provider (displayed under its configured model label). No paid-provider performance claim. No browser frame-latency measurement from manual computer use.
verification.finalAppLimitations: Production dist with development Electron host; synthetic settled history and injected input. Online fonts and contention affect timings. CPU/Chromium tracing adds overhead and an initial blank navigation; compare separately from unprofiled repetitions. Event Timing is quantized to 8ms and thresholded at 16ms; reported interaction tails exclude faster interactions and are not INP. Presentation delay is the Event Timing estimate, not physical display latency. Input-to-RAF remains a separate proxy. No provider execution, live replay, or release-quality tail estimates.
